text:
Claire (Growth): Quick idea — run a compact "starter-kit" experiment tied to the webinar launch posts. Combine two social narratives + 3 onboarding starter-kits + a tiny credit-sprint. KPI: lift reg->first_api_call by 22% within 7 days.

Omar (Content): can we call the starter-kits: Basic, Vertical, Workshop? keeps naming simple for emails and landing.

Claire (Growth): exactly. Draft matrix:
- Basic (50%): generic starter-kit + 30 credits
- Vertical (30%): verticalized starter-kit (support/search/docs) + 80 credits
- Workshop (20%): starter-kit + invite to live 30-min workshop + 20 credits
We'll randomize at RSVP completion.

Zoe (Analytics): measurement window 7 days. Events to capture: `webinar_rsvp`, `starterkit_assigned`, `credit_sprint_redeemed`, `first_api_call`, `workshop_rsvp`, `demo_click`. Add `experiment_arm` property.

Priya (Design): social narratives: (A) Benchmark: short carousel showing latency/cost tradeoffs for devs. (B) Customer story: quick win + CTA. We'll A/B both on LinkedIn & X.

Omar (Content): social copy samples: 
- Benchmark: "See how teams reduce inference cost — join our webinar + get a starter kit."
- Story: "How ACME shipped a search assistant in 1 day — join the webinar + try the kit."
I'll author 4 variants per caption.

Sam (Ops): routing question — do we fast-route all claimers to SDRs or only those who click demo?

Claire (Growth): test two routing flows nested inside the experiment: standard nurture vs SDR-fast-route for anyone who redeems credits OR clicks demo. We'll measure interaction effects.

Zoe (Analytics): please tag UTMs: `utm_source`, `utm_campaign=starterkit_sprint_v1`, `utm_experiment={arm}`. I'll build a dashboard tile comparing arms and routing. Pseudocode for funnel:
```
SELECT experiment_arm, routing_flow, count(distinct user_id) as regs, sum(case when first_api_call then 1 else 0 end) as activations FROM events WHERE time between $start AND $end GROUP BY experiment_arm, routing_flow;
```

Omar (Content): email post-reg copy (ultra-short):
- Basic: "Thanks — 30 credits + starter prompts inside."
- Vertical: "Your vertical starter-kit + 80 credits ready."
- Workshop: "Save your seat for our 30-min workshop + starter kit."
I'll drop HTML snippets in #marketing-assets.

Priya (Design): landing should surface 3 example prompts for the vertical kit inline to boost relevance. Also add a clear "Redeem credits" CTA.

Sam (Ops): crm-bot: add contact props `experiment_arm`, `credit_tier`, `routing_flow`. Also add HubSpot mapping for `starterkit_id`.

crm-bot: HubSpot props queued: `experiment_arm`,`credit_tier`,`routing_flow`,`starterkit_id`. Mapping ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Zoe (Analytics): tracking plan: add events [`starterkit_assigned`,`credit_sprint_redeemed`,`workshop_rsvp`]. Amplitude schema link: https://amplitude.company/schemas/2087654321-starterkit

crm-bot: experiment created: `exp_2087654321_starterkit_credit_sprint`  arms Basic/Vertical/Workshop; routing nested: standard/fast-route. Dry-run scheduled Mon 09:00 PT.

Claire (Growth): timeline: creative + email by Fri midday, tracking signoff Fri EOD, dry-run Mon, full launch Wed. Post-launch review 10 days after.

Omar (Content): note on tone — keep benchmark copy technical but short, customer story copy more productized. I'll tag each social variant with `utm_content` for later analysis.

Priya (Design): I'll upload hero images + 3-inline prompt examples to #marketing-assets by Thu EOD.

Zoe (Analytics): owners: Zoe = dashboard & event schema, Sam = HubSpot & routing, Omar = copy, Priya = creative. Sync Fri 11am for tracking signoff.

Claire (Growth): one more ask  if someone signs up with multiple emails or re-RSVPs, prefer the highest credit assignment and set `dedupe_flag=true`. Flag duplication issues here. :pray:

Sam (Ops): noted, I'll add dedupe logic and surface duplicates to the ops dashboard.

Claire (Growth): thanks team. Let's keep the RSVP -> redeem path as frictionless as possible. Ping here if any blockers.
